newsitem.title: USA: Celgene sees potential in SelCIDs compounds.
newsitem.headline: Celgene sees potential in SelCIDs compounds.

text.p: Celgene Corp on Wednesday said that recent data has confirmed that a group of compounds it produces may afford highly selective and active treatments for many prevalent inflammatory diseases.
The compounds, selective cytokine inhibitory drugs, or SelCIDs, were found to have potential in the treatment of such conditions as rheumatoid arthritis and inflammatory bowel disease.
Celgene anticipates that initial clinical safety studies of SelCIDs will begin in 1997.

"We are excited by the potential for these compounds, although we also recognize that significant clinical and regulatory hurdles need to be overcome before new therapies can be made available from this program," the firm said in a statement.
